LAHORE, Jan 20 (APP): WAPDA released the following figures. Indus at Tarbela: Inflows 18,600 cusecs and Outflows 30,000 cusecs; Kabul at Nowshera: Inflows 11,400 cusecs and Outflows 11,400 cusecs; Jhelum at Mangla: Inflows 9,800 cusecs and Outflows 22,000 cusecs; Chenab at Marala: Inflows 6,200 cusecs and Outflows 1,000 cusecs. Tarbela: Minimum Operating Level 1402.00 feet, Present Level 1418.27 feet, Maximum Conservation Level 1550.00 feet, Live Storage 0.244 MAF; Mangla: Minimum Operating Level 1050.00 feet, Present Level 1086.40 feet, Maximum Conservation Level 1242.00 feet, Live Storage 0.402 MAF.
